title: How a Cursor session starts in this repo
body:
Current state, as of this page. Registration of Strumentario as a stdio MCP server in the editor is pending (issue #42), so a session does not yet get the page tools as native tools.

What a session gets today:
- .cursor/rules/ load automatically. strumentario-core.mdc and hindsight-bank.mdc are always-on; the others attach by path.
- .cursor/mcp.json registers one server, the Hindsight bank "strumentario" at http://localhost:8888/mcp/strumentario/ (Orto's memory bank). It needs ORTO_HINDSIGHT_API_KEY in the environment Cursor inherits.
- AGENTS.md is the contract; ROADMAP.md says which phase is current.

To work on pages from a session today, use the CLI as a thin MCP client against a running server:
1. pnpm install && pnpm build
2. pnpm --filter @strumentario/server serve (http://localhost:3001/mcp, pages in ./.strumentario/data)
3. export STRUMENTARIO_AGENT=<an id for this session>, then call node packages/cli/dist/main.js call <tool> --json --input '...'

Pending, not available yet: stdio registration in .cursor/mcp.json (#42) and an edit skill that restricts page edits to query, validate and dry-run mutate (#43). Update this page when either lands.
